done.title: आधी रात की सीटी
done.summary: Detective Vikram investigates a locked-room death in 1920s Banaras where a young woman died after hearing a mysterious whistle.

done.title: दीवार के अंदर कौन?
done.summary: When eerie knocking echoes from a bank vault wall, Detective Vikram links it to a pawnshop clerk and a bizarre club paying a man just to copy books.

done.title: नीली साड़ी का राज़
done.summary: Detective Vikram uncovers the sinister plot behind a governess's strange employment conditions at a isolated Shimla bungalow.

done.title: अनजान कोठी का बुलावा
done.summary: A young engineer survives a descending ceiling trap and loses his thumb in a mysterious forest mansion, leading Detective Vikram to uncover a dangerous counterfeiting ring.

done.title: पाँच काली पंखुड़ियाँ
done.summary: Vikram fails to protect a young man who receives five black lotus petals, leading him to uncover a sinister smuggling network linked to his past cases.

done.title: शापित नीलम
done.summary: Detective Vikram investigates a stolen cursed sapphire found inside a festive duck in 1920s Banaras, uncovering a framing attempt and a mysterious connection to the Black Lotus.

done.title: खिड़की में दिखा चेहरा
done.summary: Detective Vikram uncovers the double life of a respectable man who has been disguising himself as a famous Banaras beggar to earn a fortune.

done.title: झील की चुड़ैल
done.summary: When a farmer is murdered near a misty lake, villagers blame a legendary ghost, but Detective Vikram uncovers a decades-old story of dacoits, blackmail, and sacrifice.

done.title: कुत्ता क्यों नहीं भौंका?
done.summary: On the eve of the Lucknow Cup, a champion racehorse vanishes and its trainer is found dead, leaving Detective Vikram to unravel the deadly secret behind a watchdog that never barked.

done.title: तहखाने का मंत्र
done.summary: Detective Vikram deciphers an ancient family riddle using geometry and the shadow of a long-dead tree to uncover an ancestral treasure and a grim murder in a Lucknow haveli.

done.title: मुट्ठी में फटा कागज़
done.summary: In 1923 Meerut, Vikram investigates a coachman's murder where the only clue is a torn scrap of paper with two distinct handwritings.

done.title: पर्दे पर अजीब पंजे
done.summary: In 1923 Meerut, Detective Vikram investigates a Colonel's death inside a locked room where the only clues are strange paw prints and a long-lost name from the Mesopotamia campaign.

done.title: बँधी आँखों का सफ़र
done.summary: In 1923 Calcutta, Vikram and his brilliant brother Raghav race to rescue a captive Tibetan trader whose desperate messages were decoded by a terrified blindfolded interpreter.

done.title: बीमार के कमरे में कौन?
done.summary: When a vital treaty vanishes from an office and someone creeps into a bedridden clerk's sickroom at midnight, Detective Vikram uncovers a desperate thief trapped by his own crime.
